name: Testing the Wells
summary: Alba Fairmoon sends you across Westfall to test the farm wells. The samples may reveal what is poisoning the soil and groundwater.

sections.title: Blight in the Aquifer
sections.body: Alba Fairmoon asks you to test Westfall's groundwater. Neglect and banditry have already hurt the open plains, and poison beneath the earth threatens the farmland that remains. You collect samples from farm wells so Alba can learn what is tainting the soil and water.

sections.title: Farms of the Frontier
sections.body: You take samples from the wells at Jansen Stead and Molsen Farm. These homesteads lie among scattered farms exposed to Defias outlaws and feral wildlife. Their well water can show whether the blight is rising from the ground, caused by magic, or deliberately put into the water that feeds the region.

faq.q: What is the purpose of Testing the Wells?
faq.answer: Alba Fairmoon wants to learn the source and nature of the poison afflicting Westfall. Fresh groundwater samples from farm wells will let her examine the contamination.
Alba Fairmoon assigns the work as she investigates the spreading corruption and unnatural poisons in Westfall.

faq.q: Which locations need to be sampled?
faq.answer: You sample the wells at Jansen Stead and Molsen Farm in Westfall.

faq.q: What is threatening Westfall's water and soil?
faq.answer: An unknown blight or poison is corrupting Westfall's land. Testing well water is the first step toward learning whether the aquifer beneath the homesteads is tainted.

faq.q: Is the contamination natural or artificial?
aliases: is the water poisoned on purpose
faq.answer: The cause is not yet known. Samples from Jansen Stead and Molsen Farm may show whether the rot comes from natural groundwater corruption or deliberate sabotage.

faq.q: Why focus on Jansen Stead and Molsen Farm?
faq.answer: Jansen Stead and Molsen Farm are established homesteads with wells that draw from the underground water table across the plains. Testing them can show how far the corruption reaches.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you know Westfall's farms must produce food for the Kingdom of Stormwind to survive. The health of their wells concerns the whole kingdom.
As a druid, you recognize that unnatural toxins in soil and fresh groundwater wound the land's balance and call for healing.
